questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Before going on my exchange to Salerno I had primarily been in Northern Italy and the possibility of getting to know the culture of Southern Italy was the crucial aspect of my choosing Salerno as destination.

Additional comments:

questions.answer: Fine, I had no problems.

questions.answer: I received assistance specifically related to my Erasmus experience which was helpful and good.

questions.answer: We just had to sign some documents and it was neatly taken care of by the staff.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Friendly and competent guidance in both English and Italian.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Completely succesful as it was no problem.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Whilst they were all BA courses some were first year and some second and third.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: More strict and the professors had more freedom and more authority and esteem of their own teaching and subjects which was very refreshing.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Letteratura italiana moderna e contemporanea
Letterature comparate
Letteratura greca e sua ricezione moderna
Teoria e traduzione letteraria

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Courses with the professors Giorgio Sica, Stefano Amendola and Vincenzo Salerno.

questions.answer: Really good student associations but very poor possibilites for physical training and sports for Erasmus students.

questions.answer: The gatherings arranged by the student organisations.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Pompei, Paestum, Salerno, Napoli.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Whilst being very different, I have experienced nothing but the warmest accommodation from the locals.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: I didn't find any particularly challenging.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: The warmth of the people and the general helpfulness and respect.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Stay in Salerno, choose courses with prof Sica, and get to know your local bar.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Nothing in particular.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: The very competent professors.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: The lack of youth culture during the weekends.

questions.answer: Yes
